lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular white spots are organized into distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating anchor nodes within a grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadowed lower boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a dense, labyrinthine (vermiculated) pattern of high-luminance markings that transitions into discrete circular spots posterior to the head.
